_source.placeholder: Name, handle, logo, colours and fonts are placeholders until gate H1 / step 050 (real brand) and H9 (channel basics). Logo is drawn in-repo, no third-party art. palette = the free Sweetie 16 palette (GrafxKid); named colours are picked from it.
_source.fonts: Family names only. 'files' (paths relative to this file) stays empty until step 040 adds an open-licence pixel font.
_source.safe_zone: Pixel insets on a 1080x1920 Reel. Top 14%, bottom 35%, sides 6% = Meta Ads Guide for Instagram Reels (https://www.facebook.com/business/ads-guide/update/video/instagram-reels), rounded up. right_rail 120 px = width of the like/comment/share/audio button column (https://www.revid.ai/instagram-reels-safe-zone, practical buffer, not a Meta figure). Checked 2026-11-17.
